title.english: An Address for a Grown Child

pairs.target: xìn dào de shíhòu , tǎ wéi zhèng tì wēn xiù jiāng liáng piàn fàng huí xiázǐ , tīngjiàn wū yà de míngzì , shǒulǐ nà piàn báo tiě pèngdào xiá yán , fāchū yìshēng hěn qīng de xiǎng .
pairs.english: When the letter arrived, Tavi was replacing Wenxiu's gauges in their case. Hearing Wuya's name, the thin iron in his hand struck the rim with a very soft sound.
pairs.hanzi: 信到的时候，塔维正替温岫将量片放回匣子，听见乌娅的名字，手里那片薄铁碰到匣沿，发出一声很轻的响。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu ràng tā diàoxiàqù , què fàngcuò le gé , wēn xiù shēn zhǐdiǎn le yíxià , tā cái huíguò shén , jiāng zuìhòu liǎngpiàn yě zhào cìxù fàng hǎo .
pairs.english: He did not drop it, but put it in the wrong slot. Wenxiu pointed; he recovered his attention and put away the final two in order.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有让它掉下去，却放错了格，温岫伸指点了一下，他才回过神，将最后两片也照次序放好。

pairs.target: cóng sè lā nàwǎn yìqǐ xiěxìn suàn qǐ , yǐjīng guò le shíbārì .
pairs.english: Eighteen days had passed since the night he wrote with Sela.
pairs.hanzi: 从瑟拉那晚一起写信算起，已经过了十八日。

pairs.target: wū yà xiān shuō wèn dé màn le xiē , lǎorén yuán bó réng yóu běnrén bǎocún , xǔjiā de quánmíng zé cóng lìng yìzhāng dāngnián de jiāojiē dān lǐ chá dào , shì xǔ zhèng mù , búshì dēngjì rén suíshǒu tián de yígè mòfáng chēnghu .
pairs.english: Wuya first apologized for slow inquiries. The old man still kept his original register; another historical handover slip gave the Xu household's full name as Xu Zhengmu, not a casual mill label supplied by a clerk.
pairs.hanzi: 乌娅先说问得慢了些，老人原簿仍由本人保存，许家的全名则从另一张当年的交接单里查到，是许正木，不是登记人随手填的一个磨坊称呼。

pairs.target: xǔ zhèng mù hòulái bānzǒu , yǔ nǚér xǔ lián tóng zhù , jiù mòfáng rújīn búzài mó liáng .
pairs.english: Xu Zhengmu had later moved to live with his daughter Xu Lian; the old mill no longer ground grain.
pairs.hanzi: 许正木后来搬走，与女儿许莲同住，旧磨坊如今不再磨粮。

pairs.target: lǎorén xiān tuōrén qù wèn jiù lín , niǎnzhuǎn zhǎodào xǔ lián , děng tā huíhuà , yòu jiāng tǎ wéi yuàn fù chāo yè hé jìxìn qián de shì shuōmíng , cái yǒu le zhècì yìqǐ jì lái de liǎngyè .
pairs.english: The old man first sent inquiries through former neighbors and found Xu Lian after several steps. He waited for her answer and explained Tavi's offer to pay copying and postage, leading to the two pages enclosed this time.
pairs.hanzi: 老人先托人去问旧邻，辗转找到许莲，等她回话，又将塔维愿付抄页和寄信钱的事说明，才有了这次一起寄来的两页。

pairs.target: dìyīzhāng réng shì jiù bó de chūchù yǔ míngzì . dìèrzhāng què búshì yòu yífèn jiāng háizi liúzài dāngnián de jìlù , érshì xǔ lián yuànyì gěi tāmen kàn de jìn xìn chāojiàn :
pairs.english: The first page still gave the old register's source and names. The second was not another record keeping children in the past, but a copy of a recent letter Xu Lian was willing to share:
pairs.hanzi: 第一张仍是旧簿的出处与名字。第二张却不是又一份将孩子留在当年的记录，而是许莲愿意给他们看的近信抄件：

pairs.target: liùzhōu qián cóng sōng dī jìhuí jiālǐ , luòkuǎn chí ān , xìn shàng jiǎng mù chǎng xīn jiē de ménchuāng huó , wèn xǔ zhèng mù jiù páozǐ de rèn hái zài bu zài , néng bunéng tì tā liú zhe .
pairs.english: Sent home from Songdi six weeks earlier and signed Chian, it described new door-and-window work at the timber yard and asked whether Xu Zhengmu still had the old plane blade and could save it for him.
pairs.hanzi: 六周前从松堤寄回家里，落款迟安，信上讲木场新接的门窗活，问许正木旧刨子的刃还在不在，能不能替他留着。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào nà jù jiù páozǐ , yòu dú huí luòkuǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi read the line about the old plane, then returned to the signature.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到那句旧刨子，又读回落款。

pairs.target: nàge wǔsuì de háizi yuánlái bìng méiyǒu yìzhí tíng zài mòfáng ménbiān , tā huì xián yìbǎ gōngjù yòng dé búshùn , huì qǐng jiālǐ bāng zhe shōu dōngxī , xiěchū de zì yǒu de jǐ , yǒu de kōng ,
pairs.english: That five-year-old had not stayed forever beside the mill door. He could dislike an awkward tool and ask home to save things; his handwriting was crowded here, spacious there,
pairs.hanzi: 那个五岁的孩子原来并没有一直停在磨坊门边，他会嫌一把工具用得不顺，会请家里帮着收东西，写出的字有的挤，有的空，

pairs.target: hé tǎ wéi rújīn jì huíqù de xìn yíyàng , búshì zhuān wèi děng yígè mòshēngrén lái rèn de .
pairs.english: like the letters Tavi sent home now, not written specially for a stranger to come and identify him.
pairs.hanzi: 和塔维如今寄回去的信一样，不是专为等一个陌生人来认的。

pairs.target: xǔ lián shuō , tā jìde jiālǐ céng zàn dài guò yígènánhái , hòulái chí ān liú le xiàlái , zhǎngdà hòu xué zuò mù huó .
pairs.english: Xu Lian said she remembered her household temporarily taking in a boy. Chian had stayed, later learning woodwork as he grew up.
pairs.hanzi: 许莲说，她记得家里曾暂带过一个男孩，后来迟安留了下来，长大后学做木活。

pairs.target: lǐng háizi lái de nàwèi nǚrén , tā zìjǐ bìng bú jìde , bùnéng tì yuán bó tiān yíjù qīnyǎn jiàn guò .
pairs.english: She did not herself remember the woman who brought the children and could not add an eyewitness claim to the old register.
pairs.hanzi: 领孩子来的那位女人，她自己并不记得，不能替原簿添一句亲眼见过。

pairs.target: chí ān yǒushí tíqǐ xiǎoshíhòu huàn guò dìfāng , tā yě méi yīncǐ zhuī zhe wèn guò lǐng sòng de rén hòulái qù le nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Chian sometimes mentioned moving as a child, but she had never pursued where his escort went afterward.
pairs.hanzi: 迟安有时提起小时候换过地方，她也没因此追着问过领送的人后来去了哪里。

pairs.target: wū yà zài hòumiàn xiě , xǔ lián yuànyì dàizhuǎn yìfēng xúnwèn xìn , fùzhuó chí ān zuìjìn liúxià de shōujiàn chù , sōng dī dōng shì liángmù chǎng , guǎn fáng zhuǎnjiāo .
pairs.english: Wuya wrote further on that Xu Lian would forward an inquiry, enclosing Chian's latest postal address: Songdi East Market Timber Yard, care of the office.
pairs.hanzi: 乌娅在后面写，许莲愿意代转一封询问信，附着迟安最近留下的收件处，松堤东市梁木场，管房转交。

pairs.target: nà shì zhè fēng jìn xìn xiě de dìzhǐ , búshì jīnrì yǒurén zài nàér wò zhe tā de shǒu hé guò ; shìfǒu réng zài , jìde duōshǎo , dōu dé děng tā zìjǐ dá , búyào ràng biérén tì tā dāying .
pairs.english: It was the address on that recent letter, not checked by someone holding his hand there today. Whether he remained and how much he remembered needed his own answer; nobody else should promise for him.
pairs.hanzi: 那是这封近信写的地址，不是今日有人在那儿握着他的手核过；是否仍在、记得多少，都得等他自己答，不要让别人替他答应。

pairs.target: xìn lǐ méiyǒu fú lán de xīn xiāoxī , yě méiyǒu bǎ tǎ wéi de míngzì tiān huí nà sāngè háizi zhīzhōng .
pairs.english: The letter contained no new news of Fulan and did not add Tavi's name among those three children.
pairs.hanzi: 信里没有芙兰的新消息，也没有把塔维的名字添回那三个孩子之中。

pairs.target: kě tā jiāng zhǐ fàngxià shí , réng juéde wūzi xiàng bǐ gāngcái xiǎo le xiē , chuāng , zhuō , dèngzǐ dōu zài yuánchù , xīn què yǐjīng xiān cháo yígè yǒurén de dìfāng zǒu le .
pairs.english: Yet putting it down, he felt the room smaller, though window, table and stool stayed where they were; his heart was already traveling toward a place with someone in it.
pairs.hanzi: 可他将纸放下时，仍觉得屋子像比刚才小了些，窗、桌、凳子都在原处，心却已经先朝一个有人的地方走了。

pairs.target: tā qù chēxíng wèn sōng dī de lù , huǒjì fānguò jiàmù cè , shuō shùnlì huàn dào chē yě yào sìrì , yùyǔ hái dé lìng suàn .
pairs.english: He asked at the cart office about Songdi. The clerk checked the fare book: even smooth connections took four days, with rain needing extra allowance.
pairs.hanzi: 他去车行问松堤的路，伙计翻过价目册，说顺利换到车也要四日，遇雨还得另算。

pairs.target: duìfāng jiàn tā méi lìkè fùqián , biàn bǎ cèzǐ liú kāi , jiào tā xiǎng hǎo nǎ rì zài lái , búbì wèile wènlù xiānmǎi yìzhāng qù bùliǎo de piào .
pairs.english: Seeing he did not immediately pay, the clerk left the book open and told him to return with a date in mind; no need to buy a ticket he could not use just to ask directions.
pairs.hanzi: 对方见他没立刻付钱，便把册子留开，叫他想好哪日再来，不必为了问路先买一张去不了的票。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng chēxíng huílái , méiyǒu qù ná qiángshàng de bēibāo .
pairs.english: Tavi came back without taking his pack off the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从车行回来，没有去拿墙上的背包。

pairs.target: tā xiānxǐ le shǒu , pà zhǎngshàng de huī yājìn xīn jì lái de zhǐ , xǐ dào shuǐ liáng le cái tíng , huíwū shí fāxiànzìjǐ hái zuàn zhe cā shǒu bù , fǎngfú yào ná tā dàitì yíjiàn yǎnxià shuō bù míngbái de shì .
pairs.english: He first washed his hands, afraid palm dust would mark the new papers, washing until the water cooled. Back inside he found he still clutched the hand cloth, as though it could stand for something he could not explain now.
pairs.hanzi: 他先洗了手，怕掌上的灰压进新寄来的纸，洗到水凉了才停，回屋时发现自己还攥着擦手布，仿佛要拿它代替一件眼下说不明白的事。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn yīwén lái zhǎo tā , jiàn zhuōshàng huàn le yìdié zhǐ , xiān wèn shìbushì bù fāngbiàn , jīnwǎn kěyǐ bù zǒu .
pairs.english: At dusk Iven came, saw a different stack of papers and first asked if it was a bad time; they need not walk tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚伊文来找他，见桌上换了一叠纸，先问是不是不方便，今晚可以不走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō méishì , quèméinéng zhàn qǐlái , biàn jiāng xìn dìguòqù , ràng tā cóng zuì qiánmiàn kàn , búshì zhī kàn nàge dìzhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi said it was fine but could not rise, so handed him the letter to read from the beginning, not just the address.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说没事，却没能站起来，便将信递过去，让他从最前面看，不是只看那个地址。

pairs.target: yīwén kàn dé màn , dúwán wèn chí ān shìbushì rújīn zuò mùjiàng . tǎ wéi diǎntóu , shuō zhìshǎo liùzhōu qián de xìn zhèyàng xiě .
pairs.english: Iven read slowly, then asked whether Chian was a carpenter now. Tavi nodded: at least the letter six weeks ago said so.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文看得慢，读完问迟安是不是如今做木匠。塔维点头，说至少六周前的信这样写。

pairs.target: yīwén yòu kàn le yìyǎn páozǐ nà jù , shuō zìjǐ wǔsuì shí zuì pà jiālǐ nà zhī gǒu , ruò xiànzài yǒurén wèn nà yìnián bān guò shénme , zhǐpà xiān xiǎng qǐlái de réng shì gǒu , zhēn méiyǒu bànfǎ bǎozhèng néng bǎ biérén yào de nà yíjù xiǎng chūlái .
pairs.english: Iven glanced at the plane sentence again: at five he had most feared the family dog. Asked now what had moved that year, he would probably first remember the dog, unable to promise the exact sentence someone wanted.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文又看了一眼刨子那句，说自己五岁时最怕家里那只狗，若现在有人问那一年搬过什么，只怕先想起来的仍是狗，真没有办法保证能把别人要的那一句想出来。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán yòu pà zìjǐ jiǎng dé tài qīng , fàngxià zhǐ , wèn tǎ wéi zuì xiǎng zhīdào shénme .
pairs.english: Then, afraid he had made light of it, he put the paper down and asked what Tavi most wanted to know.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完又怕自己讲得太轻，放下纸，问塔维最想知道什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánlái zài chēxíng lùshang xiǎng guò yíchuàn wènhuà , zhēn bèi wèn dào , fǎnér zhī shuō xiǎng zhīdào nàwèi nǚrén jiāng sāngè háizi sòng xià zhīhòu , yǒuméiyǒu zài ménkǒu zài děng yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Tavi had imagined a string of questions on the way to the cart office, but when asked, only said he wanted to know whether the woman had waited a while at the door after leaving the three children.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原来在车行路上想过一串问话，真被问到，反而只说想知道那位女人将三个孩子送下之后，有没有在门口再等一会儿。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le piànkè . yīwén méiyǒu tì nàge ménkǒu ānpái yígè jiéjú , zhī jiāng yā zhe zhǐ de kōng wǎn nuókāi , hǎo ràng tā bǎ liǎngyè yìtóng tān píng .
pairs.english: The room went quiet briefly. Iven supplied no ending for that doorway, only moved the empty bowl off the paper so he could spread both pages flat.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了片刻。伊文没有替那个门口安排一个结局，只将压着纸的空碗挪开，好让他把两页一同摊平。

pairs.target: tā shuō dìzhǐ gěi de shì yígè yǐjīng zhǎngdà de rén , ruò tǎ wéi yuànyì , zìjǐ kěyǐ xiān zài pángbiān zuò zhe , děng tā xiǎng hǎo kāitóu zài zǒu .
pairs.english: He said the address was for someone grown now; if Tavi wished, he could sit beside him until he found a beginning before leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 他说地址给的是一个已经长大的人，若塔维愿意，自己可以先在旁边坐着，等他想好开头再走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná qǐbǐ , xiě chí ān liǎnggè zì , xiǎng le xiǎng , yòu lìng qǔ yìzhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi took his pen, wrote Chian's name, thought a moment and took another sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿起笔，写迟安两个字，想了想，又另取一张纸。

pairs.target: tā bùnéng yì kāikǒu biàn jiāng duìfāng jiào chéng xǔduōnián qián de nàge háizi , yě bùxiǎng xiān xiě yì zhěngyè zìjǐ yǒu duō zháojí , xiàng dìguòqù de búshì yìfēngxìn , shì yào rén lìkè kángqǐlái de zhòngliàng .
pairs.english: He could not start by calling the man that child of many years ago, nor write a whole page about his urgency as though handing over not a letter but a weight to shoulder at once.
pairs.hanzi: 他不能一开口便将对方叫成许多年前的那个孩子，也不想先写一整页自己有多着急，像递过去的不是一封信，是要人立刻扛起来的重量。

pairs.target: nàwǎn tāmen méiyǒu chūmén . yīwén dào gāi huí huìguǎn shí cái qǐshēn , tǎ wéi sòngdào ménkǒu , shǒulǐ réng liú zhe nà zhāng zhī xiě guò míngzì de zhǐ .
pairs.english: They did not go out that night. Iven rose only when due back at the lodge; Tavi walked him to the door, still holding the sheet with only a name.
pairs.hanzi: 那晚他们没有出门。伊文到该回会馆时才起身，塔维送到门口，手里仍留着那张只写过名字的纸。

pairs.target: lóuxià yǒurén wèn tā míngzǎo hái lái bu lái liáng jià , tā dāying yìshēng , zài huítóu kàn , nà yìháng sōng dī de dìzhǐ méiyǒu biàndàn .
pairs.english: Downstairs someone asked if he was measuring the rack again tomorrow. He answered, then looked back: the Songdi address had not faded.
pairs.hanzi: 楼下有人问他明早还来不来量架，他答应一声，再回头看，那一行松堤的地址没有变淡。
